[FACT] User has been playing a lot of board games with friends and family lately.

[PREFERENCE] User enjoys games that involve creativity, imagination, and social interaction.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new board game recommendations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dixit is a great game that blends creativity, imagination, and social interaction.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended games include: Mysterium, Codenames, Taboo, Deception: Murder in Hong Kong, The Voting Game, Wits & Wagers, Junk Art, Pictomania, Monikers, Dixit: Journey, and Dixit: Daydreams.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mysterium is a cooperative game where one player is a ghost providing clues through abstract artwork.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Codenames is a word-guessing game that requires players to identify words based on one-word clues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Taboo is a fast-paced word-describing game where players describe a word without using certain "taboo" words.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Deception: Murder in Hong Kong is a social deduction game where players provide clues and alibis to convince an investigator of their innocence.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Voting Game is a party game where players vote on various topics and guess how the group will vote.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wits & Wagers is a trivia game where players bet on answers given by opponents.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Junk Art is a dexterity game where players create art pieces using random junk items.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pictomania is a drawing game where players guess what their opponents are drawing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Monikers is a party game where players guess the name of a movie, book, or other item based on a brief description.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dixit: Journey and Dixit: Daydreams are expansions or spin-offs of Dixit with new artwork and gameplay mechanics.  
[PREFERENCE] User has played Codenames before and found it to be a blast.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in Mysterium and Deception: Murder in Hong Kong.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for more strategic and complex games like Ticket to Ride or Carcassonne.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended strategic games include: Pandemic Legacy, Scythe, Terraforming Mars, El Grande, 7 Wonders, Azul, Brass: Birmingham, Caverna: The Cave Farmers, Splendor
